entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activities
entities.Description: One   interaction   that   happened   between   people ,  about   records .  Timeline   card  —  not   a   blob   store ,  not   a   task ,  not   field - level   audit .  Duration   is   derived   from   StartedAt / EndedAt .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Sort   key   for   every   timeline .  Instant   events   use   the   date / time   of   the   event .

Fields.Name: EndedAt
Fields.Description: End   of   a   meeting / call .  Leave   null   for   a   point - in - time   log .  Must   be  >=  StartedAt   when   set .  Duration   is   derived ;  do   not   store   it .

Fields.Name: Title
Fields.Description: Subject  /  one - line   card   title  ( e . g .  Called   Jane   about   renewal ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Notes   or   a   short   excerpt .  Not   the   full   email   body  —  that   lives   on   an   ActivityFile   of   Kind   Body .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Inbound ,  Outbound ,  or   Internal .  Channel   lives   on   ActivityType ;  direction   lives   here   so   inbound   email   is   a   filter ,  not   a   type   explosion .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Logged  ( default   for   a   past   event ),  Scheduled ,  Completed ,  Cancelled ,  or   Failed .

Fields.Name: Outcome
Fields.Description: Optional   disposition :  Connected ,  LeftVoicemail ,  NoAnswer ,  NoShow ,  Bounced ,  Interested ,  NotInterested .  A   filter ,  not   a   type .

Fields.Name: Visibility
Fields.Description: Internal  ( anyone   who   can   read   a   Regarding   record )  or   Private  ( LoggedByUserID   only ,  until   a   PermissionEngine   domain   exists ).  Manual   default   is   Internal ;  synced   mail   should   default   Private   in   the   engine .

Fields.Name: Source
Fields.Description: How   the   row   was   written :  Manual ,  System ,  or   Integration .

Fields.Name: SourceSystem
Fields.Description: Provider   name   for   idempotent   sync  ( Microsoft365 ,  Gmail ,  Zoom ).  Required   when   ExternalID   is   set .

Fields.Name: ExternalID
Fields.Description: Provider   message / event   id .  Unique   with   SourceSystem   where   set  —  never   dedup   by   subject .

Fields.Name: ExternalThreadID
Fields.Description: Email   or   calendar   thread   id   used   to   group   replies .

Fields.Name: Location
Fields.Description: Meeting   place   as   text .  Optional   AddressID   is   the   structured   location .

Fields.Name: Details
Fields.Description: JSON   extras   that   are   not   query   predicates :  MessageID ,  InReplyTo ,  MeetingURL ,  Mailbox ,  Folder ,  CalendarEventID .  See   ActivityDetails .

Fields.Name: SentimentScore
Fields.Description: Derived   sentiment   score   for   this   activity ,  bounded   between  - 1 . 000  ( most   negative )  and  + 1 . 000  ( most   positive ).  Populated   by   the   Activity   Tagging   and   Sentiment   feature   pipeline .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Files
entities.Description: Join   from   an   Activity   to   an   MJ   File .  Kind   Body   is   the   full   MIME / HTML  ( at   most   one   per   activity );  Attachment   and   Ics   are   extras .  Deleting   the   activity   drops   the   join ,  not   the   File .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Body  ( full   MIME / HTML ,  at   most   one   per   activity ),  Attachment ,  or   Ics .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   of   attachments .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Links
entities.Description: Attaches   an   Activity   to   a   resolved   MJ   record  ( EntityID  +  RecordID )  or   an   unresolved   identity  ( email / phone / external   user )  the   matcher   has   not   stamped   yet .  Role   says   whether   the   link   is   Regarding ,  a   participant ,  or   an   email / meeting   mailbox   role .

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: Why   this   record   is   on   the   activity :  Regarding  ( what   it   is   about ),  Participant ,  From / To / Cc / Bcc ,  Organizer / Attendee ,  or   LoggedFor  ( the   mailbox   it   was   filed   under ).

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   of   the   resolved   record .  NVARCHAR   so   composite   keys   work .  Required   with   EntityID ;  must   be   null   when   the   link   is   an   unresolved   identity .

Fields.Name: IdentityKind
Fields.Description: Email ,  Phone ,  or   ExternalUser .  Set   with   IdentityValue   when   the   participant   has   not   been   matched   to   a   Person / Org   yet .

Fields.Name: IdentityValue
Fields.Description: The   unmatched   address ,  phone ,  or   provider   user   id .  A   later   matcher   stamps   EntityID / RecordID   from   ContactMethod . Value   and   clears   these .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   within   a   role  ( To ,  then   Cc , …).

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Connection   Rule   Sets
entities.Description: Binds   a   rule   set   to   a   connection ,  ordered .  Many - to - many   so   a   mailbox   composes   an   org - wide   baseline ,  a   team   overlay ,  and   anything   specific   to   itself  —  rather   than   owning   one   private   copy   of   everything .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncRuleSetID
Fields.Description: The   rule   set   bound   to   this   connection .  A   mailbox   composes   several   sets  ( org   baseline ,  team   overlay ,  mailbox - specific )  through   this   join ;  Sequence   on   the   binding   is   the   evaluation   order .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Connections
entities.Description: A   mailbox ,  calendar ,  or   other   provider   connection   that   writes   Activities .  CredentialsRef   is   an   MJ   Credentials   engine   key  —  never   a   secret   at   rest .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   connection  ( e . g .  Amith  /  Microsoft   365 ).

Fields.Name: Provider
Fields.Description: DEPRECATED  —  use   ActivitySyncProviderTypeID .  Retained   nullable   so   a   published   host   keeps   working ;  removed   in   the   next   major .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Active ,  Paused ,  Error ,  or   Disabled .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Inbound  ( pull   into   CRM ),  Outbound ,  or   Bidirectional .

Fields.Name: CredentialsRef
Fields.Description: MJ   Credentials   engine   key .  NEVER   a   secret   value   at   rest .

Fields.Name: Mailbox
Fields.Description: Mailbox   address   this   connection   reads  ( jane @ acme . com ).

Fields.Name: LastSyncAt
Fields.Description: When   the   engine   last   completed   a   sync   for   this   connection .

Fields.Name: LastError
Fields.Description: Most   recent   sync   error ,  if   Status   is   Error .

Fields.Name: Settings
Fields.Description: JSON   provider   extras  ( TenantID ,  MailboxFolder ,  CalendarID ,  IncludeCalendar ,  IncludeMail ).  See   ActivitySyncConnectionSettings .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncProviderTypeID
Fields.Description: The   provider   type   this   connection   reads .  Supersedes   the   Provider   string   column ,  whose   CHECK   constraint   made   every   new   source   a   migration   to   Common .

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Activation   window .  Combines   with   Status :  a   connection   syncs   only   when   Status  =  Active   AND   now   is   within  [ StartAt ,  EndAt ],  treating   either   bound   as   open   when   null .  Lets   a   mailbox   be   provisioned   ahead   of   time ,  or   retired   on   a   date ,  without   anyone   remembering   to   flip   a   switch .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: End   of   the   activation   window ;  see   StartAt .  Null   means   open - ended .

Fields.Name: SkippedContentPolicy
Fields.Description: Per - connection   override   of   the   provider   type ' s   DefaultSkippedContentPolicy .  Null   inherits .  This   is   the   knob   for  " this   one   mailbox   is   sensitive "  without   changing   the   estate .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Exclusions
entities.Description: Never - ingest   list ,  by   identity :  an   email   address ,  a   phone   number ,  a   social   handle ,  or   a   whole   domain .  Rows   rather   than   a   delimited   string   because   an   exclusion   that   cannot   be   queried   cannot   be   audited ,  and   this   is   precisely   what   a   legal   hold ,  an   HR   matter   or   an   opt - out   has   to   be   able   to   prove .  Scoped   to   a   rule   set ,  or   global   when   ActivitySyncRuleSetID   is   null .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncRuleSetID
Fields.Description: Optional   rule   set   this   exclusion   belongs   to .  Null   means   global  —  the   identity   is   never   ingested   on   any   connection .  A   legal   hold   or   opt - out   is   usually   global ;  a   mailbox - specific   mute   is   not .

Fields.Name: PersonID
Fields.Description: Optional   link   to   the   Person   this   identity   belongs   to .  Optional   because   an   address   is   often   excluded   before   anyone   knows   whose   it   is ,  and   because   a   Person   has   several   ContactMethods  —  the   identity   is   the   durable   key   here ,  not   the   record .

Fields.Name: EffectiveFrom
Fields.Description: Start   of   the   window   of   MESSAGES   this   exclusion   covers ,  matched   against   the   item ' s   own   time  --  when   a   message   was   sent   or   received ,  or   when   a   meeting   starts  --  NOT   against   the   current   time .  Leave   empty   for   no   lower   bound .  This   is   deliberately   different   from   ActivitySyncConnection . StartAt ,  which   is   evaluated   against   the   clock :  setting   this   to   today   does   not   mean  " exclude   from   today   onwards ",  it   means  " exclude   messages   dated   today   or   later ",  so   a   later   backfill   of   older   mail   is   not   covered   by   it .  Item   time   is   also   what   keeps   a   re - run   reproducible ,  so   the   run   log   can   answer   which   rule   excluded   a   message   and   give   the   same   answer   next   time .

Fields.Name: EffectiveTo
Fields.Description: End   of   the   window   of   MESSAGES   this   exclusion   covers ,  matched   against   the   item ' s   own   time  --  when   a   message   was   sent   or   received ,  or   when   a   meeting   starts  --  NOT   against   the   current   time .  Leave   empty   for   no   upper   bound .  Inclusive   of   the   instant   given ,  matching   how   ActivitySyncRule   DateFrom / DateTo   compare .  See   EffectiveFrom   for   why   this   is   item   time   rather   than   clock   time .

Fields.Name: IsEnabled
Fields.Description: Whether   this   exclusion   is   in   force .  Unchecked ,  it   is   ignored   entirely   and   the   messages   it   names   are   qualified   as   if   it   did   not   exist .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Extensions
entities.Description: Registration   of   an   in - process   enrichment   plugin   that   runs   inside   the   Activity   write   transaction .  Common   ships   this   table ;  each   consumer   app   ships   its   own   rows ,  so   a   downstream   app   adds   links  ( a   deal ,  a   campaign )  without   Common   knowing   it   exists .  Extensions   ENRICH  —  they   never   veto   an   activity ,  because   qualification   has   already   run   and   capture   must   not   depend   on   which   apps   are   installed .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncProviderTypeID
Fields.Description: Optional   provider   type   this   extension   is   registered   for .  Null   means   it   runs   on   every   connection .  A   deal - linker   that   only   makes   sense   on   email   can   bind   here   rather   than   being   invoked   for   a   phone   transcript .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ascending   run   order .  REQUIRED   rather   than   incidental :  two   extensions   both   adding   links   must   not   depend   on   registration   order ,  which   varies   with   package   load   order   and   is   not   reproducible .

Fields.Name: FailurePolicy
Fields.Description: What   happens   when   this   extension   throws .  Skip  ( the   default )  records   the   error   and   commits   the   activity   without   the   enrichment ;  Abort   rolls   the   whole   write   back .  Skip   is   the   default   because   the   activity   is   worth   more   than   the   enrichment ,  and   one   buggy   consumer   app   must   not   be   able   to   halt   ingestion   for   every   other   app   on   the   host .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Provider   Types
entities.Description: A   kind   of   activity   source  ( Microsoft365 ,  Gmail ,  Twilio   SMS ,  LinkedIn , …).  Provider   identity   is   DATA ,  not   a   CHECK   constraint ,  so   a   new   source   is   a   new   plugin   package   plus   a   metadata   row  —  never   a   migration   to   Common .  Also   carries   the   DEFAULTS   an   operator   should   set   once   per   provider   rather   than   per   mailbox :  storage ,  encryption   key ,  attachment   cap ,  and   what   an   undecided   qualification   verdict   means .

Fields.Name: DefaultQualificationPolicy
Fields.Description: What   an   Undecided   qualification   verdict   means   for   this   provider   once   every   rule   stage   has   abstained .  Exclude  ( the   default )  fails   CLOSED  —  correct   for   anything   mailbox - shaped ,  where   capturing   a   private   message   is   worse   than   missing   a   business   one .

Fields.Name: DefaultSkippedContentPolicy
Fields.Description: Whether   a   SKIPPED   message   may   have   content   retained   for   audit ,  and   how   much .  None   keeps   only   the   opaque   external   id   and   the   decision .  SubjectEncrypted   and   FullEncrypted   additionally   keep   ciphertext ,  and   are   only   valid   with   DefaultEncryptionKeyID   set  —  enforced   by   CK_ActivitySyncProviderType_KeyRequired .  Overridable   per   connection .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   connector   type   may   run .  Unchecked ,  every   connection   using   it   refuses   on   its   next   fleet   tick   and   reports   Status  =  Error   with   the   reason ,  rather   than   appearing   to   sync  --  and   each   returns   to   Active   by   itself   once   the   type   is   re - enabled   and   a   run   succeeds .  Nothing   is   read   from   any   mailbox   while   it   is   off .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Rule   Sets
entities.Description: A   NAMED ,  REUSABLE   set   of   rules   bound   to   many   connections .  Rules   used   to   hang   off   a   single   connection ,  so   an   org - wide   prohibition   had   to   be   retyped   for   every   mailbox   and   a   new   mailbox   started   with   none  —  governance   by   copy - paste .  A   rule   set   is   authored   once   and   bound   wherever   it   applies .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncProviderTypeID
Fields.Description: Optional   provider   type   this   rule   set   is   written   for .  Null   means   the   set   applies   regardless   of   source  —  an   org - wide   prohibition   does   not   care   whether   the   mailbox   is   Microsoft365   or   Gmail .

Fields.Name: InternalDomains
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   the   domains   this   deployment   considers   INTERNAL ,  e . g . [" bluecypress . io "].  Required   for   any   rule   using   ParticipantScope : " internal "  is   a   property   of   the   deployment ,  not   of   a   message .  Held   on   the   rule   set   so   one   definition   serves   every   mailbox   bound   to   it .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Rules
entities.Description: Include / exclude   rule   for   an   ActivitySyncConnection :  type ,  direction ,  date   window ,  attachments ,  plus   a   JSON   Filter  ( folders ,  domains ,  participant - must - match - ContactMethod ).

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   rule .

Fields.Name: IsEnabled
Fields.Description: 0   skips   the   rule   without   deleting   it .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Evaluation   order   within   the   connection .  Lower   first .

Fields.Name: Action
Fields.Description: Include   or   Exclude   matching   items .  With   no   rules ,  the   engine   syncs   everything   the   connection   can   see .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Optional   direction   filter  ( Inbound  /  Outbound  /  Internal ).  Null  =  any .

Fields.Name: DateFrom
Fields.Description: Inclusive   lower   bound   of   the   sync   window .  Null  =  no   lower   bound .

Fields.Name: DateTo
Fields.Description: Inclusive   upper   bound   of   the   sync   window .  Null  =  no   upper   bound .

Fields.Name: IncludeAttachments
Fields.Description: 1  =  also   pull   attachments   into   ActivityFile   rows .

Fields.Name: Filter
Fields.Description: JSON   match   extras :  Folders ,  ExcludeFolders ,  Domains ,  ExcludeDomains ,  ParticipantMustMatchContactMethod ,  SubjectContains ,  SubjectExcludes .  See   ActivitySyncRuleFilter .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncRuleSetID
Fields.Description: The   rule   set   this   rule   belongs   to .  Exactly   one   of   ActivitySyncRuleSetID   and   ActivitySyncConnectionID   is   set  ( CK_ActivitySyncRule_Owner ) —  the   connection   form   is   the   deprecated   original   and   remains   only   so   existing   rows   stay   valid .

Fields.Name: ParticipantScope
Fields.Description: Which   participants   must   be   present   for   this   rule   to   apply  —  the   internal / external   control .  AllInternal   excludes   purely   internal   chatter ;  HasExternal   catches   a   thread   with   any   outside   party   on   it ;  Mixed   is   the   case   an   all - or - nothing   rule   gets   wrong .  Requires   the   rule   set   to   define   InternalDomains .  Null   means   the   rule   does   not   test   participants .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Run   Details
entities.Description: The   decision   made   about   ONE   message ,  written   for   every   item   considered   INCLUDING   every   skip  —  which   is   what   makes  " why   did   my   email   not   appear "  answerable .  ExternalID   and   the   decision   are   always   safe   to   keep :  an   opaque   provider   id   and   the   name   of   a   rule ,  not   content .  CapturedContent   is   different   in   kind   and   is   governed   by   the   effective   SkippedContentPolicy .  Give   this   entity   permissions   DISTINCT   from   Activity :  it   can   hold   fragments   of   messages   that   were   deliberately   not   ingested .

Fields.Name: DecidedByStage
Fields.Description: Which   stage   of   the   qualification   cascade   decided  —  a   rule   set   name ,  KnownParticipant ,  Inference ,  or   DefaultPolicy .  Paired   with   Reason   it   explains   an   outcome   without   retaining   the   message   that   produced   it .

Fields.Name: AIPromptRunID
Fields.Description: The   MJ :  AI   Prompt   Run   behind   an   inference - stage   verdict .  Non - null   only   when   a   model   actually   decided   this   item ,  which   is   the   audit   trail   for   every   automated   judgement   the   engine   makes .

Fields.Name: CapturedContent
Fields.Description: Ciphertext ,  always  —  never   plaintext ,  whatever   the   policy .  Present   only   when   the   effective   SkippedContentPolicy   allows   retention ,  and   always   paired   with   the   EncryptionKeyID   that   opens   it  ( CK_ActivitySyncRunDetail_ContentKey ).  Encrypted   through   MJ ' s   EncryptionEngine   against   an   MJ :  Encryption   Keys   row ;  this   app   never   implements   its   own   crypto .  ROTATING   THAT   KEY   MAKES   EXISTING   ROWS   UNREADABLE :  rotation   re - encrypts   only   fields   declared   with   Encrypt  =  1 ,  this   column   is   encrypted   by   calling   the   engine   directly ,  and   the   stored   value   records   which   key   opened   it   but   not   which   version  —  so   a   rotation   skips   these   rows   silently   and   the   next   read   of   them   fails .  Retain   content   here   only   for   as   long   as   the   key   behind   it   will   not   be   rotated ,  or   rotate   with   a   plan   for   this   column .  Tracked   upstream   as   MemberJunction / MJ # 4580 .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Runs
entities.Description: One   sync   pass   over   one   connection :  what   it   fetched ,  what   it   decided ,  and   whether   it   earned   the   right   to   move   the   watermark .  A   dry   run   is   a   real   row   with   IsDryRun   set  —  it   evaluates   and   reports   without   writing   an   Activity   or   advancing   the   connection .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Types
entities.Description: Lookup   of   interaction   channels  ( Email ,  Call ,  Meeting ,  Note ,  SMS ,  Chat ).  Hierarchy   is   picker - only ;  direction   lives   on   Activity .  Code   is   the   stable   key  —  sync   and   code   target   Code ,  never   Name .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Stable   key   targeted   by   sync   and   code  ( Email ,  Call ,  Meeting ,  Note ,  SMS ,  Chat ).  Unique .  Names   can   be   renamed ;  codes   cannot .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   picker   and   timeline .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   longer   description   of   the   type .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   class   for   timeline   chrome  ( e . g .  fa - solid   fa - envelope ).

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Optional   categorical   color   for   timeline   chrome .  Not   a   design - token  —  this   is   stored   per   type .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Picker   sort   order .  Lower   first .

Fields.Name: IsSystem
Fields.Description: 1  =  seeded   system   type   the   sync   engine   may   assume  ( Email ,  Call ,  Meeting ,  Note ,  SMS ,  Chat ).  Clients   add   children   with   IsSystem  =  0 .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: 0   hides   the   type   from   the   picker   without   deleting   historical   activities .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Address   Links
entities.Description: Polymorphic   link   table   connecting   Address   records   to   any   entity   record   in   the   system   via   EntityID   and   RecordID

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   value ( s )  of   the   linked   record .  NVARCHAR ( 700 )  to   support   concatenated   composite   keys   for   entities   without   single - valued   primary   keys

Fields.Name: IsPrimary
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   the   primary   address   for   the   linked   record .  Only   one   address   per   entity   record   should   be   marked   primary

Fields.Name: Rank
Fields.Description: Sort   order   override   for   this   specific   link .  When   NULL ,  falls   back   to   AddressType . DefaultRank .  Lower   values   appear   first

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Address   Types
entities.Description: Categories   of   addresses   such   as   Home ,  Work ,  Mailing ,  Billing

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   address   type

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   this   address   type

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   for   UI   display

Fields.Name: DefaultRank
Fields.Description: Default   sort   order   for   this   address   type   in   dropdown   lists .  Lower   values   appear   first .  Can   be   overridden   per - record   via   AddressLink . Rank

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   type   is   available   for   selection   in   the   UI .  Inactive   types   are   hidden   from   dropdowns   but   preserved   for   existing   records

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Addresses
entities.Description: Standalone   physical   address   records   linked   to   entities   via   AddressLink   for   sharing   across   people   and   organizations

Fields.Name: Line1
Fields.Description: Street   address   line   1

Fields.Name: Line2
Fields.Description: Street   address   line   2  ( suite ,  apt ,  etc .)

Fields.Name: Line3
Fields.Description: Street   address   line   3  ( additional   detail )

Fields.Name: City
Fields.Description: City   or   locality   name

Fields.Name: StateProvince
Fields.Description: State ,  province ,  or   region

Fields.Name: PostalCode
Fields.Description: Postal   or   ZIP   code

Fields.Name: Country
Fields.Description: Country   code   or   name ,  defaults   to   US

Fields.Name: Latitude
Fields.Description: Geographic   latitude   for   mapping

Fields.Name: Longitude
Fields.Description: Geographic   longitude   for   mapping

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Contact   Methods
entities.Description: Additional   contact   methods   for   people   and   organizations   beyond   the   primary   email   and   phone   fields

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: The   contact   value :  phone   number ,  email   address ,  URL ,  social   media   handle ,  etc .

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: Descriptive   label   such   as   Work   cell ,  Personal   Gmail ,  Corporate   LinkedIn

Fields.Name: IsPrimary
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   the   primary   contact   method   of   its   type   for   the   linked   person   or   organization

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Contact   Types
entities.Description: Categories   of   contact   methods   such   as   Phone ,  Mobile ,  Email ,  LinkedIn ,  Website

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   contact   type

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   this   contact   type

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   for   UI   display

Fields.Name: DisplayRank
Fields.Description: Sort   order   in   dropdown   lists .  Lower   values   appear   first

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   type   is   available   for   selection   in   the   UI .  Inactive   types   are   hidden   from   dropdowns   but   preserved   for   existing   records

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Job   Functions
entities.Description: Business   job   functions  ( Engineering ,  Marketing ,  Sales ,  etc .)  for   categorizing   roles   and   career   paths .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   display   name   of   the   job   function .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   job   function   and   the   roles   it   encompasses .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   sort   sequence   order .
